confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web-searched Interlaken menu prices and Swiss cost-of-living figures, converted from CHF at an assumed 1.25 USD per CHF (not searched). Some sources are undated or hotel-based and may skew high. Beer, coffee and the inexpensive meal are the firmest; the two-person meal, cocktail and wine anchors are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of July resort rates, with no accommodation search or live listing check, so they are the least certain. The FX value is the RBA observation for 2026-11-18 from RBA exchange-rate pages surfaced by search; the F11.1 table itself was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Swiss national price levels with a summer resort premium, comparable to other Swiss alpine tourist towns such as Lucerne and Grindelwald. Accommodation reflects general knowledge rather than a city-specific search.
